summary: Bathla Group, the insolvent Australian property developer that’s shaken the nation’s real estate and private credit market, secured stopgap funding that will help it stay afloat for now even as its broader debt crisis still looms.

summary: Gold held a decline, after stronger-than-expected US payrolls data and escalating tensions in the Middle East raised the prospects for an interest-rate hike as early as next week.

summary: Japan likely sold a portion of its holdings of foreign securities, including US Treasuries, to finance its record currency intervention over the past month.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for September 7
title_cn: 9 月 7 日最新石油市场新闻和分析
summary: Oil climbed after the US attacked Iranian tankers and Tehran declared a new restricted zone outside the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the waterway.

title: Japan's Go President Eyes Expansion in Asia, Robotaxis
title_cn: 日本 Go 总裁着眼于亚洲扩张，Robotaxis
summary: Go, the taxi booking app operator that pulled off Japan’s biggest initial public offering this year, is eyeing ways to expand domestically and across Asia, and doesn't see competitors like Uber as a threat. Go President Hiroshi Nakajima spoke exclusively with Bloomberg's Shery Ahn about Japan's unique ride-hailing market and future opportunities like robotaxis. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China Injects Billions of Capital Into Banks, Insurers
title_cn: 中国向银行和保险公司注入数十亿资本
summary: China is injecting billions into its largest banks and insurers to shore up balance sheets and sustain growth in a slowing economy. Bloomberg's Sunny Bangia explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: A Goldman Sachs Group Inc. strategist is standing by his bullish target for South Korean stocks, saying investors underestimate how long the AI boost for the nation’s memory chipmakers will last.

title: Bloomberg This Weekend 09/06/2026
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by BBC Chief International Correspondent Lyse Doucet, AFL-CIO President Liz Shuler, Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens and California Rep. Kevin Kiley. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: 尖！彭博社针对冒险者的每周新闻测验
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini, and Jeff Mason as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: NBA Hits Clippers With Historic Penalties
title_cn: NBA给快船队历史性的处罚
summary: The NBA fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and stripped the franchise of five first-round draft picks after an independent investigation found the team circumvented salary-cap rules by facilitating off-court income opportunities for Kawhi Leonard. Bloomberg News Senior Sports Reporter Randall Williams joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains that owner Steve Ballmer was also suspended for a year, while Leonard was fined $700,000 in one of the league’s most severe disciplinary actions. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Stevens Says Canadian Tariffs Are Squeezing Michigan
title_cn: 众议员史蒂文斯表示加拿大关税正在挤压密歇根州
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Michigan Representative Haley Stevens (D) says escalating US tariffs on Canadian goods are raising costs and creating uncertainty for manufacturers in her district, with the deeply integrated auto supply chain particularly exposed. Stevens tells hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that she is promoting legislation that would provide households with as much as $1,700 to offset tariff-related costs, while criticizing the Trump administration’s approach to trade with Canada. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: British Food Is Having a US Moment
title_cn: 英国美食正在走向美国
summary: British food is enjoying new popularity in the US, with a wave of pub-inspired restaurants drawing crowds with traditional dishes served in more modern settings. Bloomberg Pursuits Contributing Restaurant Columnist Oliver Guy and Anchor of Daybreak Europe Caroline Hepker sit down with Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and say social media, travel and demand for affordable comfort food are helping fuel the trend, with New York’s Dean’s among the restaurants putting classics such as stargazy pie and bubble and squeak back in the spotlight. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: USS Lincoln Sailors Describe Toll of Deployment
title_cn: 林肯号航空母舰水兵描述部署造成的损失
summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln’s crew received a long-awaited port visit in Thailand after a 286-day deployment that included a modern-era record of 264 consecutive days at sea and months of combat operations in the Middle East. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Southeast Asia Reporter Philip Heijmans who recently returned from Thailand and says sailors described food shortages, limited communications with family and uncertainty over their return, while many also expressed pride in their mission. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Races to Boost Missile Interceptor Output
title_cn: 美国竞相提高导弹拦截弹输出
summary: The US retains significant munitions capacity for operations against Iran, but stocks of sophisticated interceptors missiles have come under greater pressure. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Defense Analyst Col. Wayne Sanders tells  tells Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend that manufacturers are being pushed to sharply increase production, a process complicated by sprawling supply chains and concerns about preserving advanced weapons for other potential conflicts. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Says Canada’s Dollar ‘Imbalance’ With US Is Unacceptable

summary: “Canada’s (currency) Dollar imbalance with the U.S. is unacceptable,” President Donald Trump says in a Truth Social post.

title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
title_cn: 顺便说一句：您可能错过的头条新闻
summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce settling in Ohio, parents teaching teens to invest, what happened to yoga classes, and baseball dogs: Watch Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason talk about headlines from this week you may have missed on Bloomberg This Weekend! (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Envoys Test New Opening in Ukraine Talks
title_cn: 美国特使测试乌克兰会谈的新开端
summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv for their first official visit to Ukraine after more than three hours of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow produced no announced breakthrough. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News Chief Europe Correspondent Oliver Crook says the renewed US effort comes as Ukraine’s deeper strikes into Russia have altered the dynamics of the conflict, while European governments are watching the diplomacy with cautious optimism. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Japanese Stocks Advance as Tech, Chip Shares Follow US Peers
title_cn: 日本股市上涨，科技股、芯片股追随美国同行
summary: Japanese stocks rose, driven by tech and chip shares, following a surge in AI and semiconductor-related names in the US on Friday. Signs of stabilizing interest rates also helped assure investors.

title: Goldman-Backed Taxi App Says Ridership Good Despite Fare Hikes
title_cn: 高盛支持的出租车应用程序表示，尽管票价上涨，但乘客量仍然良好
summary: Go Inc., the taxi booking app operator that pulled off Japan’s biggest initial public offering this year, said it is sustaining strong ride volume even after fare hikes.

title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overshoots Runway, Closing Miami Airport
title_cn: 亚马逊货机冲出跑道导致迈阿密机场关闭
summary: An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and burst into flames on Sunday, shutting down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompting an emergency response. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Also: The latest on Apple’s big Sept. 9 event.

title: Nigeria’s Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Exit From Country
title_cn: 尼日利亚反垄断机构调查 Uber 退出该国的情况
summary: Nigeria’s antitrust commission said it is probing Uber Technologies Inc.’s abrupt exit from the West African nation, after the ride-hailing platform shut down last week without prior notice to users.

title: Democratic Candidate for Ohio Governor Accosted at County Fair
title_cn: 俄亥俄州州长民主党候选人在县博览会上搭讪
summary: An armed individual lunged at Amy Acton, the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, at a county fair on Sunday, drawing swift condemnation from her Republican opponent and Governor Mike DeWine.

title: Healey to Pitch UK Regional Growth Paired With Fiscal Discipline
title_cn: 希利将推动英国区域增长与财政纪律相结合
summary: John Healey plans to put regional growth at the heart of his economic vision, while vowing fiscal discipline, in his first major speech as chancellor of the exchequer on Monday.

title: China Expands Patrols Off Taiwan's Pacific Coast, Raising Maritime Tensions
title_cn: 中国扩大在台湾太平洋沿岸的巡逻，加剧海上紧张局势
summary: For decades, China’s maritime pressure on Taiwan centered on the major shipping strait separating the two neighbors. Now, Beijing is piling unprecedented pressure on its Pacific coast — a vital lifeline with US allies.

title: Ex-Governor Pataki Has Lung Harm From 9/11 Toxins, NY Post Says
title_cn: 《纽约邮报》称，前州长帕塔基因 9/11 事件毒素而肺部受伤
summary: Former New York Governor George Pataki says he has lung disease from being exposed to toxins from the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks on the World Trade Center in Manhattan, according to the New York Post.

title: German Far-Right AfD Set to Win State Vote, Short of Majority
title_cn: 德国极右翼选择党将赢得州选举，但未获得多数席位
summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany scored its best-ever result in a state election on Sunday amid growing public discontent with the political establishment, delivering a powerful blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Bloomberg's Oliver Crook explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iran, US Trade Tanker Attacks as Tehran Warns of Restricted Zone
title_cn: 德黑兰警告设立禁区，伊朗与美国贸易油轮遇袭
summary: Iran said it targeted three oil tankers using an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz, as well as a number of US-linked ships, in retaliation for American attacks on Iranian tankers over the weekend.

title: German Far Right Scores Best Result Ever in State Election
title_cn: 德国极右翼在州选举中取得有史以来最好成绩
summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany scored its best-ever result in a state election on Sunday amid growing public discontent with the political establishment, delivering a powerful blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz and the country’s political establishment.

title: Sierra Leone Ex-Ruler Returns Home After Treason Charges Dropped
title_cn: 塞拉利昂前统治者在叛国罪指控撤销后返回家园
summary: Former Sierra Leone President Ernest Bai Koroma, accused of plotting to overthrow the government, has returned from Nigeria after criminal charges against him were dropped.

title: Lavrov Warns That Germany Is Moving Toward War With Russia
title_cn: 拉夫罗夫警告德国正在走向与俄罗斯的战争
summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov accused Germany of moving toward a direct confrontation with Russia as he criticized Berlin’s decision to close some diplomatic offices after a drone incident at Leipzig airport.

title: Zelenskyy Sees No Fast End to War After Meeting With US Envoys
title_cn: 泽伦斯基在会见美国特使后认为战争不会快速结束
summary: Ukraine is resigned to Russia’s war dragging on through another tough winter and is looking for a “package” from allies that would cover air defense reinforcements as well as energy, including US LNG.

title: Trump’s ‘Erratic’ Tariffs Undermine Economy, House Democrat Says
title_cn: 众议院民主党人称特朗普“不稳定”的关税损害了经济
summary: Democratic Representative Haley Stevens blasted the “erratic” tariff war that President Donald Trump started with Canada, saying her home state of Michigan is bearing much of the economic fallout from the trade dispute.

title: French National Rally’s Bardella on Budget, AI, Ukraine
title_cn: 法国全国集会的巴尔德拉谈预算、人工智能、乌克兰
summary: France's National Rally will oppose any proposals by the current government for tax increases in the next budget, according to the president of the far-right party, Jordan Bardella. He also touted the strong transatlantic relationship with the US, and said he believes France should receive something from Ukraine in exchange for continued support. Bardella spoke exclusively with Bloomberg Television Anchor Francine Lacqua from Lake Como in Cernobbio, Italy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bardella ‘Certain’ to Oppose Tax Increase in French Budget Fight
title_cn: 巴尔德拉“肯定”反对法国预算斗争中增税
summary: Jordan Bardella, head of the far-right National Rally party, set out his red lines for the battle over narrowing France’s yawning budget deficit ahead of the 2027 presidential campaign, vowing to fight any tax hike on households and business.

title: France’s Far-Right Chief Bardella Wants Ukraine to Pay for Europe’s Help
title_cn: 法国极右翼领袖巴尔德拉希望乌克兰为欧洲的帮助付费
summary: Jordan Bardella, president of the far-right National Rally party, said France’s unconditional support for Ukraine should be replaced by a more transactional relationship with the embattled country.

title: German Far Right Heads for Historic State Win: What to Watch
title_cn: 德国极右翼有望取得历史性的国家胜利：看点
summary: Germany’s far right is expected to notch a decisive election victory in Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday, a result that could put the Alternative for Germany, or AfD, closer than ever to leading one of the country’s 16 states.

title: US Energy Chief Says Navy to Defend Hormuz Until Iran Backs Down
title_cn: 美国能源部长表示海军将保卫霍尔木兹海峡直到伊朗让步
summary: US Navy escorts that are helping tankers cross the Strait of Hormuz are essential to sustaining crude flows through the waterway, Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Sunday, suggesting they won’t end anytime soon.

title: Rep. Kiley Challenges Party Control in Congress
title_cn: 众议员基利挑战党在国会的控制
summary: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Independent California Rep. Kevin Kiley is calling for House rules to guarantee committee assignments for lawmakers who don't belong to either major party, after his own assignments were temporarily vacated when he left the Republican Conference. Kiley also criticizes mid-decade gerrymandering and said he supports mail voting while arguing that nationwide election policy should be set by Congress rather than executive order. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Envoys, Zelenskyy Joined by European Allies in Kyiv Meeting
title_cn: 美国特使、泽伦斯基与欧洲盟友一起参加基辅会议
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with President Donald Trump’s envoys in Kyiv, a day after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Moscow with President Vladimir Putin in pursuit of a way to end Russia’s war in Ukraine.

title: Trump Rallies GOP Ahead of Midterm Elections
title_cn: 特朗普在中期选举前集结共和党
summary: Republicans are preparing for a first-of-its-kind midterm convention in Dallas on Sept. 9 and 10, with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance among the featured speakers as the party seeks to mobilize voters ahead of November. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend is Co-host of Bloomberg's Balance of Power Kailey Leinz and she says that the gathering will also spotlight competitive races including the Texas Senate contest, even as some Republicans in swing districts plan to stay away and campaign at home. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Unions Gains Support as AI Reshapes Work
title_cn: 人工智能重塑工作，工会获得支持
summary: A Gallup poll shows 71% of Americans approve of labor unions and a record 47% want them to have more influence, while 52% of Republicans also approve. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is AFL-CIO President Liz Shuler and she says unions are organizing around wages, AI and the midterms as House Republicans investigate whether some unions improperly used member dues for political activity, allegations Shuler rejects. (Source: Bloomberg)
